questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a 35 mph speed zone after the curve ahead.
Drive no less than 35 mph around the curve ahead.
Curve ahead, speeds of 35 mph or slower are recommended.
Stay in the right-hand lane if not driving over 35 mph.

questions.correctAnswerText: Curve ahead, speeds of 35 mph or slower are recommended.
questions.explanation: A curve is coming. The sign recommends driving at 35 mph or slower through the curve.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Construction workers on or near the roadway.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow diamonds with black markings. They alert you to hazards ahead. This sign warns that pedestrians may be crossing the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Lane ends or roadway narrows ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Lane ends or roadway narrows ahead.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow diamonds with black markings. They alert you to hazards ahead. This sign warns that the right lane is ending or the road is getting narrower.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a yield sign. Slow down and check for traffic. Let pedestrians and other vehicles pass before you go. Only stop if necessary.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A divided highway is starting. Stay to the right of the divider or median.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They prepare you for hazards ahead. This sign tells you that lanes are shifting. Follow the new lane direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow diamonds with black markings. They alert you to hazards ahead. This sign warns that the divided highway is ending.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: That the right lane ends and traffic should merge left.

questions.correctAnswerText: That the right lane ends and traffic should merge left.
questions.explanation: The right lane is ending. Traffic in the right lane must move left to merge with other lanes.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Traffic lights are arranged so red is always on top (vertical) or left (horizontal). Green is always on the bottom (vertical) or right (horizontal).

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Pennant-shaped signs indicate a no passing zone.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A series of curves is ahead.
The road will be slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road will be slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns drivers that the road becomes slippery when it is wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells drivers not to block the intersection. These signs enforce rules that drivers must follow.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange construction signs warn drivers about roadwork ahead. This sign directs drivers to take a different route around construction work.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign shows the height of an overpass ahead. Do not proceed if your vehicle is taller than the height shown on the sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. They alert drivers to hazards ahead. This sign warns you of a steep hill coming up so you can adjust your speed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells drivers to wait for the left turn signal before turning left. It enforces traffic rules.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that your vehicle will be towed if you park in this area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Sharp right turn in the road ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Sharp right turn in the road ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that there is a sharp right turn ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must drive slowly and sound your horn.
You are entering a school's parking lot.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and alert drivers to hazards ahead. This sign means a school zone is coming. Slow down and watch for children.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead curves left, then right.
The road ahead curves right, then left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead curves right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road curves right and then left ahead. Slow down to safely navigate these curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells you that left turns are not allowed at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Eight-sided signs mean you must stop. Come to a complete stop and yield the right-of-way. You may proceed when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you not to enter the roadway from this direction. It is often posted at the end of one-way streets. Stop and turn around if you see this sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is posted at traffic lights where you cannot turn right on a red light.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you to stay in the right lane to avoid a hazard ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that bicycles may be on the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: May either continue through the interchange or exit the freeway from your current lane.
May stay in your lane and continue through the interchange.
Must exit the freeway, if you stay in your current lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Must exit the freeway, if you stay in your current lane.
questions.explanation: An "Exit only" sign means the lane does not continue on the freeway. If you stay in this lane, you must exit. You can change lanes if you want to continue on the freeway.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs with black markings alert you to upcoming road conditions and hazards. This sign warns you that an intersection is coming up.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Cars in right lane must slow down.
Pass only in the right lane.

questions.explanation: This sign warns you that two lanes of traffic are about to combine into one lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange construction signs warn you about construction zones. This sign tells you the right lane ahead will be closed due to construction.
